title: 30mc-2001-young-gun-championship
label: Billy Blaze

won.source: the promotion's own first TV Taping (4 August 2001)

how: Defeated Lars (his own Pretty in Pink partner and the belt's other former co-champion) with a schoolboy rollup, unifying the promotion's two old Young Guns titles into one. (ended: lost the title)

label: Harry Palmer

won.source: the promotion's own served weekly broadcasts, August-December 2001

how: Awarded the match, and the title, when referee Orly Diaz counted champion Angel out of the ring at ten -- a finish the broadcast never explains.
